inventory.visualPurpose: Vitamin D synthesis and activation cascade
inventory.sourceFigureDescription: Flowchart: 7-dehydrocholesterol + UVB → cholecalciferol (D3) → 25-OH in liver → 1,25-(OH)2 in kidney (PTH ↑, phosphate ↓ regulate) → intestinal Ca/P absorption, bone mineralization

notes: The genu varum photograph (label A) is drawn as a diagnostic-pattern-preserving KYP original (standing toddler, knee-gap arrow). The synthesis/regulation figure is an original KYP redraw preserving the source's boxes (D3/D2, 25-OH D3, 1,25-(OH)2 D3), enzymes (25-hydroxylase, 1α-hydroxylase), regulation loop, and the three target-organ effects.
